fix: Remote access from browser and phone (Block 24b): a separate gateway listener (off by default) serves a mobile web app (PWA) and a fixed read-only whitelist (login/logout/me/info and the three monitoring routes). Plain HTTP only on loopback; Tailscale mode stays on 127.0.0.1 and `tailscale serve` adds HTTPS for the tailnet, LAN mode needs a certificate. Cookie session (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict, 30 min idle / 12 h), same-origin and JSON-only writes, strict CSP, no CORS. Login brake (10 failures / 15 min, also for the local login). TOTP (RFC 6238, node:crypto) with 10 recovery codes; required remotely for admin/operator. Remote access per user, off by default; narrowing access ends remote sessions. Source link (AGPL-3.0 §13) on every page. Fix: audit entries of the auth routes were recorded as "[object Object]".
